hypothesis: Impossible optimistic continuation values maintain avoidable negative progress. Projecting only values above an action-support and smoothing-consistent optimistic reachability envelope improves closed-loop outcomes beyond distance-only clipping, geometric replacement, and existing fixed-prefix MPPI.
difference: Inference-time upper projection of the frozen critic, no training or global head refit. Bound earliest possible goal entry along the successor-to-goal direction using the support of the original80 raw actions and the exact smoothing recurrence; ignore humans for an optimistic necessary condition, not a safety guarantee.
novelty: UNVERIFIED. Admissible heuristics, value bounds and neural repair are established. Only the additional executable finite-action envelope versus distance-only cap is a candidate difference. No paper PASS from a development win alone.

shared.reward: unchanged: terminal success1; nonterminal rewards nonpositive

math: For successor position x, velocity v, goal g, d=|g-x|, e=(g-x)/d, m=max_a e.a, alpha=.3: maximum projected displacement in n future steps is dt*(n*m+(e.v-m)*alpha*(1-alpha^n)/(1-alpha)). First n with displacement >= d-radius is an optimistic lower bound on arrival steps. U=gamma^(max(n-1,0)); U=0 if no success possible before native timeout. V_used=min(V,U). Candidate terminal precedence remains original.

development.note: Existing development cases. Nominal and hold8 complete results reused byte-identically from policy-handoff. No fresh claim.

confirmation.conditional: development signal plus credible independent mechanism required

go: No fewer successes and no more collisions/contacts than every comparator AND either at least2 extra successes or at least5% lower paired both-success time versus strongest simple; envelope changes actions relative to distance-cap; mean decision<50ms. Otherwise KILL. No parameter rescue. Fresh paired interval must exclude zero on the registered benefit metric.
